verdict.rationale: Dagster supports local development via `dg dev`/scaffold tooling, asset checks for data quality, and integrations like dlt/DuckDB that community sources confirm are used for local dev-to-prod workflows (dagster-comm-8, dagster-comm-9). However, there's no explicit first-party guidance on swapping a 'lightweight destination' (e.g., DuckDB) for local testing before pointing at production, and community feedback notes debugging friction. missing for 10: explicit docs/example on local-to-prod destination swapping (e.g., DuckDB→Snowflake pattern), independent hands-on confirmation of smooth local testing workflow, and resource definitions/config-based environment switching guidance.
